name: Yume no Kizuna
source:
Dreams are the bonds between people... 

Suspended in a dream-like ether of time... 

In her dream, a girl encounters and reunites with two other girls, young exorcists in the care of their mother who is the same. But on the new moon of their youth, a sudden event... 

In a castle research facility, a goddess is created not unlike the moon goddess who lived thousands of years ago. But enemies pursue her for a very different, devious plan... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE088884.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
梦，是人与人之间的羁绊…

悬浮在如梦似幻的时间之中…

少女在梦中与另外两名少女相遇、重逢。那两人是年轻的驱魔师，由同为驱魔师的母亲照料。然而，就在她们年少时的一个新月之夜，突发的变故…

一座城堡的研究设施中，人们创造出一位女神，与数千年前存在的月之女神颇为相似。但敌人为了一个截然不同的阴险计划，开始追捕她…

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE088884.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
